_comment: B1 field equivalence — the three clearance shapes the extended schema now accepts. Entry 0 (auto) and entry 2 (manual) are the SAME kind + distances; the ONLY structural difference is the geometry SOURCE (face_id vs geometry). This is the exact shape ManualPrimitiveJobTests asserts the app emits and core/tests/unit/test_job.cpp::test_clearances_manual asserts the core parses.

clearances._: AUTO bolt — geometry re-read from the B-rep via face_id (unchanged, pre-handoff shape)
MANUAL face — a hand-placed slab the finder missed; inline geometry, no B-rep face
MANUAL bolt — same kind + distances as entry 0; differs ONLY in geometry vs face_id
